Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer agent failed to extract the specific death place from the ThePeerage page it was viewing. In Step 6, the agent loaded the page (https://www.thepeerage.com/p2778.htm) which clearly lists the death date ("d. 22 Mar 1865") for George Augustus Frederick Henry Bridgeman, 2nd Earl of Bradford, but the visible text in the viewport does not show the death place. Despite the Planner's explicit instruction to "locate the death date and the death place" and "extract the death place exactly as listed," the WebSurfer incorrectly reported the death place as "Weston Park, Staffordshire, England." This information was not present in the visible portion of the page provided in the conversation history (which only showed the mother's death place and the children's birth/death dates). The agent hallucinated or misattributed the death place, likely confusing it with the family seat mentioned elsewhere or the location from the Wikipedia snippet, rather than reading the actual data from the source it was instructed to analyze. This error propagated the discrepancy between the two sources (Weston Park vs. Weston-under-Lizard) without resolving it.
